title: Why Texas bands sounded unlike Piron's New Orleans band
summary: Albert says Texas bands had different feeling because they knew few New Orleans musicians. Dick notes stock arrangements sound different in each band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
